I answered Hollis in #central-team: the signed paperwork puts Marrow Agrisupply at 40 seats, not the 382 Tobias posted. I also told him I'd taken Tobias's number on Oct 14 without checking it.

- **What the paperwork says:** The 2026 renewal (signed Apr 22, running May 1 2026 to Apr 30 2027) leaves Agrisupply's seats as the earlier Affiliate Amendment set them. That amendment, effective Oct 15 2025, sets them at 40. June emailed Hollis the same number on Oct 2 2025. I found nothing that raises Agrisupply to 382, and I don't know where that number came from. I suggested Hollis ask Tobias.
- **Correction posted:** My first reply also compared 382 with Fieldworks' 95 seats, which made no sense. I posted a follow-up telling Hollis to ignore that part.
- **Access:** Hollis is in #central-team, so he could already see Tobias's post. I couldn't open the renewal or the amendment in the files Hollis can access; I read them in gbrain. Seat counts can be shared with the account's team, so I quoted only the seat count and dates and left out all pricing.
- **Stray post:** My summary of the Oct 14 turn also appears in #central-team as its own message (posted at 09:00 that day). I didn't remove it.
